svg.text: CURRICULUM VITAE
CASEY CHEN
Chicago, IL | casey.chen@example.com
OBJECTIVE
Controller and CPA with 18 years in accounting and financial operations. Leads a
6-person team across 3 entities, connecting accurate reporting, disciplined controls,
and an efficient month-end close. Background includes hands-on delivery, collaboration
across departments, reporting, staff support and planning. Interested in a senior
position that builds on this experience and offers the opportunity to take on broader
responsibility.
SKILLS
CPA; U.S. GAAP; NetSuite; multi-entity reporting; close management; internal controls;
audit coordination; Attention to detail; organized; Excel; Microsoft Office; teamwork;
analytical; deadlines; journal entries; accounting systems.
EMPLOYMENT
Financial Controller | Summit Components Inc. | 2020–present / Prepare and review
monthly financial statements, journal entries, accruals and balance-sheet
reconciliations. Assign work to the accounting team, monitor close deadlines and respond
to questions from department managers. Review intercompany balances and ensure
supporting documentation is available for management and external auditors. Lead a
6-person accounting team responsible for reporting, reconciliations, and close
activities across 3 entities. Maintain the close checklist, review reconciliations and
follow up on outstanding information from other departments. Document recurring entries
and review procedures, discuss exceptions with the team and keep records of approvals.
Prepare monthly variance explanations and investigate differences between the ledger and
supporting schedules. Standardized supporting schedules and review handoffs; the team’s
close cycle moved from 10 to 7 business days. Prepare audit support, coordinate requests
with external accountants and follow up with internal owners. Review accounting
procedures, maintain supporting files and help resolve questions about transactions.
Work with operations on inventory-related entries and with finance leadership on
management reporting and planning requests. Coordinate external-audit schedules and
internal review owners, delivering assigned requests by agreed deadlines.
PREVIOUS ROLE
Senior Accountant | Summit Components Inc. | 2013–2020 / Owned 35 monthly balance-sheet
reconciliations, investigated discrepancies, and documented resolutions before sign-off.
Prepared variance explanations and maintained review documentation for management and
external auditors. Supported inventory accounting with operations. Maintained supporting
documentation, kept team priorities current and provided updates during regular planning
and review meetings. Worked with colleagues to resolve requests and communicate
outstanding work.
EDUCATION
M.S. Accounting | Prairie State University | 2012; B.S. Accounting | Prairie State
University | 2008; CPA, Illinois (active)
Accounting Associate | River Services Co. | 2008–2013
Managed vendor-invoice support and resolved purchase-order discrepancies before payment runs. Maintained
transaction records and supporting schedules, escalating exceptions for review before month-end. Built
practical knowledge of the organization’s systems and procedures, maintained working records and supported
colleagues with daily priorities.
